newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Jan-Feb tax collection fall below target.
newsitem.headline: Russia Jan-Feb tax collection fall below target.

text.p: Russia's tax collection over January and February amounted to 34.1 trillion roubles, or 29.5 trillion roubles below target, a document compiled by the budget committee of the State Duma lower house of parliament said.
The document attributed the shortfall to low collection of value added tax, excise duties and profit tax.
Poor tax collection is one of the most acute economic problems in Russia and prompted the International Monetary Fund to suspend payment of some of tranches of its $10 billion loan.
Some loans were later disbursed, but January and February tranches are not yet approved, in part due to low budget revenues.
